comments.author: Ankita7033
comments.body: I'd like to fix this. The example has three issues: inputs = ...().to(model.device) references model before it's defined, torch_device is never defined, and device_map="auto" is passed to .to() (it's a from_pretrained argument, not a .to() argument). I'll correct the example so model is created first with device_map="auto" in from_pretrained, then move inputs to model.device. PR incoming.
